blocks.text: (The company no longer prints on the old type of paper, for now this will be the new paper.)

INCREDIBLE EVENTS IN SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY- (We did the first part of this in the March 2000 letter) - Spectacular wonders will occur as the nations repopulate and science will reach a super zenith! Let us take the subject of our galaxy and of the heavens above. It is actually a 3 fold prophecy for the past, present and future one thousand years! Amos 9:2, Though they dig into hell thence shall mine hand take them; though they climb up to heaven, thence will | bring them down. Isa. 60:8, Who are these that fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows? Obad. 1:4, Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle, and though thou set thy nest among the stars, thence will | bring thee down, saith the Lord. - Duet: 30:4, If any of thine be driven out unto the outmost parts of heaven, from thence will the Lord thy God gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee. The first thing that this reveals is man will start a tower of Babel. No matter how far men will go they cannot escape for he will fetch them back! It reveals climb. We’ve seen men step by step go higher into the sky even to the moon. And even at this very time the year 2000 it seems they are like doves carrying up piece by piece to build the International space station to be completed in the next few years! They have been actually climbing into the heavens little by little. But the last part of these prophecies will evidently be finished during the millennium. Actually as Jesus reveals, more knowledge and secrets when he speaks of building a nest among the stars. This is not in the planetary galaxy so it is evidently out in the constellation of our solar system. Nest speaks of actually bringing forth children and etc. Part of this will take place before Armageddon and the next part during the millennium. If they were not going out to these places, he would not say he would bring them back. We could reveal much more but it gives you a view point for you to study yourself. Before we finish this, we list some other events.

WONDROUS EVENTS - During this time there will be very little sickness, sin or mischief if any. Science and technology will be used for good, men will probably also farm the sea! The Lord will probably recede the ocean some. Also he will make the earth most fertile after Armageddon and the crops will be super abundance for long life. A beautiful era for the nations and great cities again. Note: During the 1000 years children will die at a hundred; men and women will still look young and beautiful at 300 or 400 years old. They have something similar to the days of Adam and Eve. Orders will come from Jerusalem from Jesus! But now there is a sad note. When the 1000 years begin to end the seeds of rebellion start from certain nations. For satan is released again for a season. (Rev. 20:3) Evidently sometime during the last generation of that period some of the nations return to severe wickedness, idols, and eventually satan will convince them he is God and the worship of satan instead of God. (They no longer go up to Jerusalem to worship the King!) Remember its like so many fell from heaven with him, so many false nations will join him. Because of representatives do not go to Jerusalem God brings on a severe drought. (Zech.14:17-18) So we see there was a type of weather, but no cataclysmic tornadoes and etc. until satan was loose again. After this long period he deceives some of the nations, but not most of them. It says they come up with him from the 4 quarters of the earth. (Rev.20:7-8) But this is not Gog and Magog of Ezek Chap 38 a 1000 years earlier.

CONTINUING- Satan is called the prince and power of the air. At one time Lucifer overshadowed when the Lord was in his bodily throne, but he should have known that the Lord is omnipresent. While he thought he was above God, the spirit of God was above him and out in eternity creating. We have an omnipotent Saviour. So at the end of the millennium satan probably attacks from space stations etc. but God is above and foresees it and what is happening on earth. And he is in the bodily form (Jesus) in Jerusalem as satan goes up and surrounds the city of the King. This is his final onslaught forever. In a moments time God calls fire out of heaven and cast him and his followers in the lake of fire where the beast and false prophet was cast a thousand years earlier. (Rev.20:1-10) Note: The people that continue their faith in Jesus during the thousand years are saved. It’s Jesus’ way of finally gleaning, in his mercy, the last ones that prove to love him. You would think the people would remember a thousand years earlier the atomic holocaust that practically destroyed this planet until the Lord intervened and cleaned it up, but it’s predestination working. Now remember the elect was translated with him somewhere near a thousand years earlier and stood by his side and doing their duties for him. After Jesus ended the conflict with satan in a twinkling of an eye all go directly to and are brought together to the White Throne Judgement. After this process we have a new heavens and new earth. (Rev. Chap. 21 and 22) And the holy city comes down out of heaven above this new earth. “Where the elect bride dwell with him throughout eternity and they shall do all that he commands of them, but he will always be with them forever.” Amen! There is so much to write of during this period of a thousand years that we just don’t have time to write but you can get a general view.
NOTE: Before the thousand years events start above we will foretell of events that precede it. Now we will write of the present and the future.

SIGNIFICANT SIGN - Dan 9:26-27 - Seventy percent of the Jewish Covenant has already been agreed on and prepared. Even though they are still in their arguments and turmoil with the Arabs, at the appointed time it will be confirmed. Several more nations will agree. In February 2000 the Pope signed a certain agreement with PLO leader Arafat which is a leader of some Arab states. When the anti-christ is unveiled he will confirm the other works which will be done by the USA and Israel. According to prophets this foreshadows the soon return of Jesus.

CELESTIAL SIGNS- CNN News showed amazing pictures from a sky telescope of the sun exploding reaching its 11 years cycle spots. Now it will mix with the new cycle that will be bringing tremendous upheavals in nature, as the scripts predicted and blending into the Biblical proportions spoken of in Rev. Chaps 6,8,16 - FIRE FROM THE SKY As the scripts predict because forewarnings of smaller and diverse sizes of fire balls, meteors, comets,and asteroids have been striking the earth, sea and lately the Arctic. And a short period ahead some huge ones will come! The apocalyptic ones will appear, (Rev. 8:8-10) striking the sea and earth. Some scientists don’t know when exactly. Four independent groups that study this phenomenon reported that a comet, star fragments or asteroid sometimes don’t leave a calling card, but just comes suddenly from the heavens. And they said the impact could be beyond belief and assumed it would be sooner than later.

CONTINUING PROPHECY - Luke 21:11 speaks of various signs including the above. It foretells of fearful and awesome signs including atomic, satanic light and other heavenly celestial phenomenon. An incredible sign from the heavens took place in England, where two USA Air Force bases were. The Commander of these bases said it was a very mysterious event! First, Air Force guards on duty saw beautiful lights appearing in the woods from the sky! It was so real the Commander went the second night and saw things so miraculous and beautiful, he said they were not of this earth. To make a long story short, they saw where they had landed and went back up into the heavens. Then would cast rays of light down in front of them as if to convince them of the reality of what they were seeing. He said you could feel the magnetism in the air! In the last sightings they saw dozens of lights gathering and then flashed away! Some of these things looked like what the prophet saw in (Ezek. Chap 1). Nevertheless satan can also show things. Even then it is a sign of the end! The Commander said some of the men were so disturbed some thought they were aliens and others, the Second coming of Christ. The main officer said, you can say what you want to, but it was real. These phenomenons show us Jesus is soon to return.
Matt. 25:6-10 The midnight hour is striking, the night is far spent! We must work now Harvest is ending. Events of a great magnitude will soon
